explication: Diagram Design is an agent skill for turning natural-language requests into branded, self-contained HTML+SVG diagrams. The main workflow is user prompt → agent selects a diagram type and creates the HTML diagram; repository utilities then support self-checking, import normalization, and SVG/PNG export. The README documents 45 diagram types and Draw.io, Mermaid, and Excalidraw import. The provided tree and excerpts show the import/export helpers and examples, but not the skill instructions or renderer implementation, so those links are documented rather than source-verified.
